title: Coarse-solver drift detector (concept prototype)
idea: compare the ML prediction to a cheap numerical solve; divergence reveals drift even when the prediction still obeys the physics
note: stand-in physics; the residual barely moves while the true error grows, but the coarse-drift signal tracks the true error and fires near the real failure. Next: wire to real FNO.

real_fno_detection.conclusion: On REAL FNO the coarse-drift detector times the failure exactly (corr 1.0), where M1 residual trust fired at t=0.1-0.3. Detects the smooth-drift failure that ANCHOR residual-based triggering structurally cannot.
real_fno_detection.open_question: cost - the reference must be made CHEAP (coarse) to still beat pure-numerical; next step.
